history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: Our ongoing journey as a Christian community in Honduras
history.paragraph1: Eternal Life Ministry grew as a community of prayer, worship, and biblical teaching, consistently serving families in San Pedro Sula and surrounding areas.
history.paragraph2: Over time, the ministry strengthened its work through life houses, congregational worship services, community outreach brigades, missions, and spiritual formation for children, youth, and adults.
history.paragraph3: Today we remain focused on discipleship, service, and Gospel proclamation through practical action: pastoral care, social support, and projects for local church growth.
history.missionText: To bring the love of Christ to every person, transforming lives through biblical teaching, discipleship, and community service.
history.visionText: To be a faith community that impacts Honduras and the world with the Gospel, forming disciples and serving with love.
